question: Identify schools that are exclusively virtual (Virtual = 'F'), have at least one student with a total SAT score of 1500 or higher (NumGE1500 > 0), and are located in counties where more than 20% of charter schools are locally funded. Return the school name, its county, and the percentage of locally funded charter schools in that county.

prediction.sql:
WITH county_charter_stats AS (
    SELECT
        XCL_045 AS county,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_065 = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS pct_locally_funded
    FROM schools
    WHERE XCL_063 = 1
    GROUP BY XCL_045
    HAVING CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_065 = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) > 20
)
SELECT
    s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
    s.XCL_045 AS county,
    ccs.pct_locally_funded
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN satscores sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
INNER JOIN county_charter_stats ccs ON s.XCL_045 = ccs.county
WHERE s.XCL_076 = 'F'
  AND sat.XCL_040 > 0

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH county_charter_stats AS (
    SELECT
        XCL_045 AS county,
        CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_065 = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS pct_locally_funded
    FROM schools
    WHERE XCL_063 = 1
    GROUP BY XCL_045
    HAVING CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_065 = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) > 20
)
SELECT
    s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
    s.XCL_045 AS county,
    ccs.pct_locally_funded
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN satscores sat ON s.XCL_041 = sat.XCL_030
INNER JOIN county_charter_stats ccs ON s.XCL_045 = ccs.county
WHERE s.XCL_076 = 'F'
  AND sat.XCL_040 > 0
